mapping.draft_py:
# Apothecary Stomper (FDN). Vigilance (compiled keyword, kept).
# "When this creature enters, choose one --
#   * Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
#   * You gain 4 life."
# The compiled tree held "You gain 4 life." on the creature's cast carrier (orphaned, BACKLOG):
# this record replaces the whole tree. Trigger and modes: M21 Trufflesnout's verified ETB
# Choose(count 1); the counters: Feat of Resistance's TARGET "creature you control" with count 2
# (Phylath's PUT_COUNTER count); the life bullet is the compiled B5c-bullet-gain-life atom, moved
# off the carrier. The carrier is the plain SpellAbility(CREATURE).
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Choose(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        options=(
            A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
                'count': QConst(value=2),
                'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            }),
            compiled[0].effect,
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE)]
